desc:
Welcome to ASMR Obby World! 

Climb, collect, explore, fight, or squish! Active or AFK. 

Build and grow your pet collection to earn more and do more .

There is no wrong way to play. Explore a whole world of cozy ASMR adventures awaits!

NOTE: Turn you graphics setting up until you can see the towers in the distance. Should work on all devices. 

🎁 Use NEW code rebalancereward since I had to rebalance some upgrades.
2,500 Coins

Update notes: 
Pen upgrades added with jump pad
New Blind Boxes with stronger pets
Rebalanced Pen max coins and Jump Pad  upgrades costs
Added naming and arranging pets in Pen
Checkpoints in the towers pay based on total pet power (new stat viewable in pet menu)
